parts: Use case: style-transfer. Production sprite sheet for Cocos 2D game 桃园小英雄. Reference image 1 is APPROVED exact youthful identity design; reference images 2/3 show existing separated head/body parts only as structural examples. Replace all five adult heroes with the clean-shaven teenage chibi designs in image 1, matching hair, clothes, bright saturated flat cel shading, crisp smooth dark brown outlines, lively large expressive eyes. Generate a truly TRANSPARENT 5-column x 3-row sprite atlas, no text, no labels, no grid lines or backdrop. Columns left-to-right Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Kongming. Row 1 ONLY floating heads facing slightly right, front three-quarter view, eyes OPEN: Liu tousled brown fringe, topknot green bow and large ears, mischievous smiling mouth; Guan green headwrap gold band red jewel, warm peach skin NOT red, brown ponytail serious face; Zhang spiky brown hair red headband, exuberant big fang smile NO beard; Zhao silver helmet cobalt blue plume youthful blue eyes; Kong dark scholar cap green gem, dark fringe, gentle bright eyes, NO mustache or goatee. Row 2 is EXACTLY SAME heads same outlines/hair/scale/neck/position and expression but with eyes briefly CLOSED for blinking. Mouth must NOT change. Row3 ONLY tiny headless armless legless torso tunics: green ivory red sash Liu; green gold armor Guan; purple ivory tunic red sash Zhang; silver cobalt armor Zhao; white jade robe Kong. Torso cut off cleanly at neck, no faces/heads/hands/arms/feet/weapons. All rows evenly spaced, 15 separate unconnected pieces, all pieces fully contained in individual cells with a transparent gutter, heads similar visible width; torso broad and short bean shape width to height ~1.4. Do not draw fullbody anywhere, no weapons or scenery. Use bold simplified shapes readable with heads rendered100pixels wide. Preserve real transparency, no cast shadows or glow. This is a game-ready layered sprite sheet not a concept board.
portraits: Use case: style-transfer. Create production fullbody transparent character portraits for the game 桃园小英雄, exact youthful identities from reference1 approved design and reference2 generated head/robe parts. References3 and4 are OLD adult portrait layout examples only, DO NOT copy adult faces or facial hair. Need 5 columns x2 rows,10 fully separate complete bodies on genuine transparent background without ground shadows, text, borders, or background. Column order Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Kongming. Top row happy determined teenage warriors, bottom row same five visibly defeated and CRYING with large blue tears down BOTH cheeks and sad frowning mouth (never smiling when defeated). Same hairstyles/clothes and teenage hairless faces as approved design. Tiny bean bodies and short tiny feet, oversized heads (head is 60% of whole bodyheight), two arms, chibi 1.7heads tall, bright saturated flat colors and smooth clean dark brown outlines readable tiny. Liu green/ivory tunic red sash, unruly brown fringe/topknot/green bow and holds one golden straw sandal firmly in EACH fist (2 sandals). Guan green headwrap/gold band red jewel, warm peach face NOT red, dark ponytail, green/gold short armor, both hands grip bamboo pole. Zhang dark spiky hair red headband, purple robe/red sash, holds narrow sharp silver pig-sticking knife with a pointed tip and dark handle in one fist and empty other fist. Zhao silver blue armor and helmet with cobalt plume, holds silver spear and blue tassel. Kong dark scholar cap green jewel white/jade robe feather fan. NO mustaches or beards. Keep weapons fully within their own cells and no overlap with neighboring portraits. Top and bottom characters same scale and weapon identity, complete hair to soles. Very clean transparent gutters. Exact consistent character identity with input1 approved concept and input2 youth parts.
